description: Evaluates whether tdk-sub-workspace-docs generates the five-file arc42-lite docs set (README, architecture, interfaces, data-flow, engineering) in init mode, creates only the missing data-flow.md in update mode while preserving bytes outside AUTO-GEN markers, and keeps the data-flow mermaid diagram a faithful subset of the edge table. No automated runner exists; score by hand or with an LLM judge.

evals.prompt: --sub-workspace api on a configured sub-workspace whose docs folder <docsPath>/sub-workspaces/api/ does not exist yet.
evals.expected_output: Resolver reports mode init. Writer creates all 5 files: README.md, architecture.md, interfaces.md, data-flow.md, engineering.md. data-flow.md has one 'Data Flow Edges' AUTO-GEN section containing the edge table followed by one fenced mermaid block, and a separate 'State and Persistence' AUTO-GEN section.
assertions: All 5 files exist in the output dir: README.md, architecture.md, interfaces.md, data-flow.md, engineering.md
Every generated file keeps its AUTO-GEN-START/AUTO-GEN-END marker pairs intact around generated bodies

data-flow.md section 'Data Flow Edges' contains a markdown table with columns From | To | Payload | Sync/Async | Evidence, followed by exactly one fenced mermaid block inside the same AUTO-GEN section
The mermaid block uses 'flowchart LR', nodes as id[label], edges as -->|payload| for sync and -.->|payload| for async
The mermaid block contains no 'subgraph', 'style', or 'class' keyword
Every edge drawn in the mermaid diagram has a corresponding row in the edge table (the diagram is a subset of the table; the table is the source of truth)
The edge table has at most 15 rows
No value in the Payload column contains an unescaped '|' character that breaks the table structure
data-flow.md section 'State and Persistence' contains a markdown table with columns Store | Owner module | Data held | Read by | Evidence
Generated bodies contain no TODO, FIXME, or {placeholder} text

evals.prompt: --sub-workspace api on a sub-workspace whose docs folder already holds exactly the four legacy files README.md, architecture.md, interfaces.md, engineering.md with AUTO-GEN markers.
evals.expected_output: Resolver reports mode update with existingFiles listing exactly the 4 present files (not a hard-coded list). Writer creates data-flow.md fresh from its template, splices AUTO-GEN bodies of the 4 existing files, and leaves every byte outside AUTO-GEN markers unchanged in those 4 files.
assertions: The resolver envelope existingFiles field lists exactly the 4 files present on disk, proving the writer payload reflects real state rather than a hard-coded array
data-flow.md is created and did not exist before the run
The 4 pre-existing files keep every byte outside their AUTO-GEN marker pairs identical to the pre-run state (verifiable with git diff on a baseline commit)
The writer does not emit BLOCKED or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS caused by attempting to read a data-flow.md that does not exist yet
data-flow.md satisfies the same structural assertions as eval 1 (table plus mermaid in one section, mermaid subset of table, cap 15 rows)

evals.prompt: Inspect the data-flow.md produced by either mode for node vocabulary discipline.
evals.expected_output: Node names in both the edge table and the mermaid diagram reuse component names from architecture.md 'Building Blocks'; nodes are modules or packages, never single files; every node id used in an edge is declared.
assertions: Every node name appearing in the mermaid diagram matches a component listed in architecture.md 'Building Blocks'
No node refers to a single file (for example a lone composable, class, or script filename)
Every node id referenced by an edge is declared in the diagram
Every mermaid edge has a matching row in the edge table and no mermaid edge exists without one (subset contract; dropped table rows are tolerated, invented edges are not)
The diagram has at most 15 edges
